entities.summary: Abubakar Bukola Saraki MBBS is a Nigerian politician who served as the 13th president of the Nigerian Senate from 2015 to 2019. He was elected the President of Nigeria's 8th Senate on 9 June 2015 under the All Progressives Congress (APC).
